# **FG-07 \-- 040 \-- Track Order Status** 

1. # **Use-Case Name** 

   1. ## **Brief Description**

   The Customer checks the authoritative processing/shipping progress of an order they own, using available status timestamps and shipping information.

   Functional group: FG-07 — Order Management

   Actor(s): Customer (C)

   Priority: Core

2. # **Flow of Events**

   1. ## **Basic Flow** 

   1\. The Customer opens an order from My Orders.

   2\. The System verifies the session and ownership of the order.

   3\. The System retrieves order fulfillment status and available state transitions.

   4\. The System shows an ordered timeline (e.g., pending, confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered) only for states actually emitted by Backend.

   5\. The Customer requests Refresh or revisits the view.

   6\. The System displays the latest verified status and timestamp.

   

   

   

   

   

   2. ## **Alternative Flows**

      1. ### *Input validation and business-rule alternatives*

   A1. The order remains pending or is cancelled: show the actual terminal/pending state, not a fabricated shipment.

   A2. A courier/tracking number is unavailable: show status only and omit nonexistent tracking links.

         1. #### State and authorization conditions

   A3. The order was not found or belongs to another customer: deny details.

   A4. A status update is delayed or service times out: show last verified timestamp and retry control.

      2. ### *Additional outcomes and service failures*

   A5. The API returns a status unknown to the UI: show a neutral fallback, not an invented delivered state.

   

3. # **Special Requirements**

   

   1. ## **Use-case quality and integrity constraints**

   • Fulfillment status and payment status must remain distinguishable.

   • Only server-confirmed events belong on the timeline; timestamps use a consistent time zone.

   • Notifications, courier tracking and other external integrations are conditional on implemented APIs.

   

 


4. # **Preconditions**

   

   1. ## **Conditions that must hold**

   • Customer is logged in and owns the target order.

   • The order has a known current state in the Backend.

5. # **Postconditions**

   

   1. ## **Success and failure states**

   Success:

   • Verified tracking status and event history are displayed.

   

   Failure:

   • No unauthorized status or fabricated delivery milestone is displayed.

6. # **Extension Points** {#extension-points}

   

   1. ## **Related use cases and scope** {#related-use-cases-and-scope}

   No formal UML extension point is defined. No named \<\<extend\>\> location is defined in the current shared use-case model. Related: UC-039 Order History & Details, UC-044 Process Customer Orders, UC-058 Ask AI About Order Status.

   Scope: Design prototype only, not evidence of implemented functionality. Editable Figma: https\://www\.figma.com/design/ZaEAO591vMKfAqftZszlyG?node-id=2-67
